findings.evidence: The contract conflates raw received SSE/JSON wire bytes with parsed events, JSON-decoded answer deltas, and final answer bytes. Those domains have different chunk boundaries and counts, so exact limits, strict UTF-8, terminal, inactivity, and post-terminal behavior do not target one implementable protocol contract.
findings.correction_outcome: Define separate wire, SSE event, JSON event, answer-delta, and final-answer stages; assign exact byte units, limits, UTF-8 ownership, inactivity reset, and terminal derivation; add adversarial splits and exact-plus-one vectors in every governed domain.

findings.evidence: The receipt self-asserts streaming and repeats metrics without binding them to response-header streaming, the resolved raw adapter, request stream mode, protocol/media type, or physical raw-read provenance. A synthetic aggregate response can therefore produce internally consistent fake chunks.
findings.correction_outcome: Make the raw transport adapter the sole observation authority and bind each attempt to candidate, case, request, adapter implementation/version/hash, provider API/config fingerprint, canonical streaming request fingerprint, response-header disposition, protocol/media type, and physical EOF. Add an aggregate-handler forgery vector that must be rejected.
